content.short: MakerDAO is the foundational DeFi protocol behind the DAI stablecoin, allowing permissionless borrowing.
content.description: MakerDAO is one of the most foundational and successful decentralized finance protocols, responsible for the creation of DAI, the industry's leading decentralized, over-collateralized stablecoin. Built on the Ethereum network, the protocol allows users to lock up various digital assets as collateral to mint DAI, maintaining its value peg through a sophisticated system of stability fees and liquidation auctions. Governed by the community through the MKR token.
